title: introduce-savings-playbook-orchestrator-and-tenant-templates
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: provide a small, opinionated orchestrator that wires tenant-level savings templates (batching, cache ttl heuristics, quant profiles) into runtime defaults and exposes a dry-run savings estimator. This PR adds a 'Savings Playbook' concept to the econ service to make tenant defaults declarative and traceable. Scope: 1) orchestrator service and CLI to apply per-tenant templates; 2) a lightweight cache-thermostat controller that adjusts prefix caching TTLs based on recent hit-rate/latency; 3) a small set of curated quantization profiles tied to tenant SLAs; 4) a dry-run estimator that simulates cost delta for a template without changing production routing. Checklist: - [x] add SavingsPlaybook API and storage model - [x] implement cache-thermostat with safe ramping - [x] provide three starter tenant templates (startup, scale, enterprise) - [x] wire telemetry (savings_estimate, applied_templates, cache_ttl_adjustments) - [x] add CLI dry-run mode and unit tests - [x] docs and examples in docs/savings-playbook.md How to review: focus on the orchestrator safety gates (rollback window, manual approval for >20% estimated change) and cache-thermostat ramp algorithm. Related: ENG-2041 implements templated defaults workstream; SUP-8721 surfaced a customer request to automate tenant defaults. Important notes: the estimator uses historical token-distribution sampling (no user content is exported) and all applied templates are recorded in tenant audit logs. The change intentionally avoids any automatic quant profile swaps above 'moderate' risk without an explicit opt-in flag.
commits: add: savings playbook API and storage model
feat: cache-thermostat controller with ramping policy

docs: savings playbook overview and examples

Noah Brooks: Telemetry naming looks good but please include a counter for forced-rollbacks and an invariant check during apply.
Maya Chen: Included forced_rollback counter and an invariant assertion that applied_templates are idempotent; added e2e smoke test.
release_notes: New: Savings Playbook orchestrator to apply tenant-level batching/caching defaults; New: cache-thermostat controller for safe TTL adjustments; New: dry-run savings estimator CLI and three starter tenant templates.
notes_for_ops: Ops: the thermostat seeds with historical hit-rate data and will require an initial calibration window (configured in charts as thermostat.initialWindow=12h). Rolling restart of econ pods recommended after deploy. Set feature flag 'savings_playbook.enabled' per-tenant before applying templates to avoid accidental sweep.
